primary_analysis_status: locked completed nested-CV OOF results; this extension does not retune base models or thresholds
secondary_analysis_status: post-hoc manuscript extension: age/risk/diagnosis subgroup summaries and paired reclassification
exploratory_analysis_status: post-hoc exploratory: error structure, XAI, and surrogate-tree fidelity
sensitivity_analysis_status: selection sensitivity using the predictor-complete cohort; not external or temporal validation
paired_binary_difference_ci: Newcombe method 10 score interval for paired proportions
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within each pre-defined comparison family
supplementary_reporting_crosschecks: PROBAST+AI (quality/risk-of-bias/applicability audit; not a reporting checklist)
non_applicable_current_stage: DECIDE-AI - reserved for live early-stage clinical evaluation
SPIRIT-AI/CONSORT-AI - reserved for prospective interventional/randomized studies
note: No base estimator is retrained and no OOF threshold is changed by this script.
